rights: Publisher CC BY-NC-ND4.0 and source terms retained with originals. No original articles, figures or bulk workbooks committed; curated factual summaries and provenance only.
limitations: No independent biological replication for real liquor; sequential doses are not independent samples.
No closed ore-to-product mass balance, purity analysis resolving all contaminant phases, or real-liquor matched broth control.
Dose denominator differs from starting biological volumes; negative recoveries and zero-cell censoring are unresolved.
Single-Nd phase identification does not establish mixed-leachate product identity.
TEA/LCA are model outputs, not deployment evidence.
